title: Day 692 — US Reopens Border to Mexican Cattle Exports at Agua Prieta, Sonora After 14-Month Screwworm Ban
detail: On August 24, 2026 (Day 692, Monday), the United States reopened the Agua Prieta (Sonora)–Douglas (Arizona) crossing to Mexican cattle exports, ending a suspension imposed after the first New World screwworm (gusano barrenador) case was detected in a Chiapas bovine in November 2024; the ban had blocked roughly 1.7 million head of cattle worth an estimated $2.2 billion. President Sheinbaum said she received a letter from U.S. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins notifying her of the decision. The reopening follows a joint SADER–SENASICA–USDA sanitary action plan and enhanced traceability across a 200-km radius in Sonora and Chihuahua; an initial shipment of roughly 750 head crossed on the first day, with a target of 1,700–2,000 head per day at full capacity. Additional crossings — San Jerónimo-Santa Teresa and Puerto Palomas-Columbus, both linking Chihuahua to New Mexico — are slated to follow in a staggered rollout.

media.caption: Mexican cattle cross into the US at Agua Prieta, Sonora as the 14-month screwworm export ban lifts

title: Day 692 — Sheinbaum Calls PRI's Alito Moreno "Entreguista, Traidor" Over US Tour, Flags $120K Consultancy Contract to INE
detail: On August 24, 2026 (Day 692, Monday), President Sheinbaum escalated her criticism of PRI national leader Alejandro "Alito" Moreno Cárdenas, calling him "entreguista, traidor" over his repeated trips to Washington to lobby U.S. officials against her government. She said it was up to the INE to determine whether Moreno's reported $120,000-a-month contract with Washington firm Concord Hill Strategies — covering trip logistics and image/wardrobe coaching for his meetings with Trump administration and Congressional officials — violated Mexican political-party financing rules, adding that his "funciones están en EEUU y no en México." The comments follow Interior Undersecretary Ariadna Montiel's earlier accusation that Moreno's US visits sought "protección" from domestic corruption investigations. Separately, Sheinbaum said she was not consulted on Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya's brief Aug 21 return to office — "me enteré por la publicación" — and deferred to the state Congress on the succession.

media.caption: Sheinbaum calls PRI leader Alejandro "Alito" Moreno "entreguista, traidor" over his US lobbying tour
